name: humanify-ag
description: Deobfuscate a minified JavaScript bundle into a readable, version-stable source tree. The pipeline is the Rust binary (crates/humanify-ag-cli) and the measurement harness is `cargo dev` (crates/humanify-ag-dev); this package holds only what the binary's webcrack shim (tools/webcrack-shim.ts, webpack/browserify unpacking) needs at run time.
author: Jesse Luoto
